m: गो—गण m. pl. a multitude of rays of light, BhP. iv, 16, 14.
गो—गमन n. intercourse with a cow, Prāyaśc.
गो—गति (गो-), f. the way or path of cows, AV. xx, 129, 13.

s: strI, (gOrgfzwiH gOreva gfzwirityarTaH । jAtyA samAse paranipAtaH .) sakftprasUtA gOH । iti kecit ॥
v: strI gOrgfzwiH jAtyA samAse paranipAtaH । sakftprasUtAyAM gavi si॰ kO॰ ।
m: गो—गृष्टि f. (= गृष्टि) a young cow which has had only one calf, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 65, Kāś.

s: klI, (gordvitvam । go + dvitve goyugac .) godvayam । (“paSuByaH sTAnadvizawke gozWagoyugazaqgavam .” iti mugDaboDasUtram ॥)
v: na॰ gavordvitvam go + dvitve goyugac । gavordvitve ।

s: klI, (goH sTAnam । go + sTAne gozWac .) gosTAnam । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥
v: na॰ goH sTAnam go + sTAne gozWac । gavAM sTAne ।
m: गो—गोष्ठ n. a station for cattle, cow-stable, Pāṇ. v, 2, 29, Vārtt. 3, Pat. (cf. गवां ग्˚, Mn. iv, 58.)
the ceremony of presenting a mouthful of grass to a cow when performing an expiatory rite, W.
the feeding like a cow, L.
गो—ग्रह m. capture of cattle, booty, MBh. vi, 4458
गो—ग्रह—तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, KapSaṃh.

s: puM, (goniHsfto granTiriva .) karIzaH । (gorgranTirbAhulyAt ekatra granTanaM yatra .) gozWam । (gorgranTiriva .) gojihvikOzaDiH । iti medinI । Te । 19 ॥
v: pu॰ gorjAto granTiH । 1 karIze । gorgranTiryatra । 2 gozWasTAne । 3 gorgranTiriva । gojihvikozaDO medi॰ ।
